# Contraptions

Small machines by Sarth Calhoun. Used at Third Wall Studio.
https://contraptions.bookofsarth.com/
https://sarth.net
https://thirdwallstudio.com

## Image Compare Workbench
Drop a folder of images. Click a reference on one rail, click candidates on the other. The camera stays put. Local, in the browser.
https://contraptions.bookofsarth.com/image-compare-workbench
https://contraptions.bookofsarth.com/image-compare-workbench.json
https://github.com/whiddershins/image-compare-workbench

## Soundscape One
A 2D field of sound. You walk; the mix follows.
https://whiddershins.github.io/WebAudioSoundscape_01/
https://github.com/whiddershins/WebAudioSoundscape_01

## Burlap
Native macOS infinite canvas for visual reference prompting.
https://burlap.app/download
